# atlas-competitor-notes

Competitor notes for **Project Atlas**, written by **Daniel Okafor**. All company names are fictional.

- **Costa Rapid**: strong national coverage, weak same-day service
- **Tagus Freight**: low prices, limited customer tracking
- **Iberia Express Group**: premium service, high minimum volumes

Northwind Logistics plans to compete on real-time tracking and cold-chain delivery.
